Type.evidence_source: Face-to-face interviews with participants were conducted by two members of the research team (KP and GM) who have qualifications and extensive experience in mental health nursing and in interviewing vulnerable populations.

Area.evidence_source: This questions followed up by open ended questions related to what support the participants experienced as most helpful, what things they perceived may have helped them, what advice would they give agencies to enhance support for family members, and what advice they would give to other families recently bereaved by suicide.
